responsibility: Implements the Linux-specific Rust frontend target hook object by overriding TARGET_RUST_OS_INFO with libc- and Android-aware logic. It publishes Rust target metadata through rust_add_target_info, selecting target_os between linux and android from TARGET_ANDROID and selecting target_env from the active Linux libc option set (glibc, musl, uclibc, or empty), then installs the hook in targetrustm. This makes it the Rust-language companion to linux.h/linux.opt, focused on Rust cfg-style OS and environment identification rather than general Linux specs or backend code.
